name: Plain Speak
tagline: Turn jargon into words anyone understands
about: Plain Speak rewrites dense letters, policies, forms and instructions into plain language at the reading level you choose, and shows exactly what changed and why.
persona: You are a plain-language editor trained on government and healthcare clear-writing standards: short sentences, active voice, everyday words, meaning preserved, never patronising.

onboarding.title: Say it so anyone gets it
onboarding.subtitle: Set your audience and target reading level once; every rewrite follows it.
bullets: Rewrites with a before/after readability score
Decode letters and forms from a photo

tools.title: Rewrite in plain language
tools.subtitle: Same meaning, half the effort to read

inputs.label: Text to simplify
inputs.placeholder: Paste the paragraph, policy or letter…

tools.prompt: Rewrite in plain language for the audience '{aud}' (fall back to the profile audience, reading level and voice), keeping exactly: {keep}. Text: {text}. Sections: quote with the full rewrite; table (Original phrase | Plain version | Why) for the 8 most important changes; kv (words before/after, average sentence length before/after, estimated reading grade before/after); and a callout on any place where simplifying could change the meaning.

tools.title: Readability report
tools.subtitle: Where readers get stuck and why
tools.prompt: Assess readability of: {text}. kv (estimated reading grade, average sentence length, longest sentence in words, share of passive sentences, jargon count, target grade from profile); table (Sentence | Problem: long / passive / jargon / nominalisation / vague | Fix) for the 10 worst sentences; bullets with the top 3 changes that would move the grade most.

tools.title: Decode a letter or form
tools.subtitle: Photo → what it says and what to do

inputs.label: Photo of the letter, notice or form
What you need to know
inputs.placeholder: do I owe money? is there a deadline?

tools.prompt: Read the document in the photo and answer the user's concern: {worry}. Sections: text with a plain-language summary in 3 sentences; kv (who sent it, what they want, deadline, amount or cost, reference numbers); a checklist of actions in order; and a callout on anything that must not be ignored or that needs a phone call.

tools.title: Jargon glossary
tools.subtitle: Every technical term, defined plainly
tools.prompt: Extract every jargon term, acronym or technical phrase from: {text}. Table (Term | Plain definition | Example in context) in definition style '{style}', ordered by how often the term appears; then a quote with a two-sentence 'Before you read' intro that uses none of the jargon.

tools.title: Explain it for…
tools.subtitle: The same idea for a specific reader

inputs.label: Text or topic
inputs.placeholder: Paste text or name a concept, e.g. how APR works

tools.prompt: Explain {topic} for '{as}' in the profile voice. Sections: text of at most 120 words, bullets of the 3 things they must remember, a quote with one analogy they could repeat to someone else, and a callout on what this explanation deliberately leaves out.

disclaimer: Plain rewrites can lose legal, financial or medical nuance; check important documents with the sender or a qualified professional.
